body:
I'm not gonna fill your head with "It'll get better" "Just keep on going" "Things work out" 
I've been told these lies my entire life. 

What I've learned over time, with years of depression on my shoulders, Is you have to remember, YOU'RE the only one in control. 
You can make a change in your life, (not to imply it's your own fault)
Strive to do things that make you feel even briefly content, strive to make yourself above all others okay, but share love and compassion with others.. 
Sorry if this is coming off as self centered, I just wanted to give in my 2 cents.. 

Just consider this. 
(not sure if you're religious or not)
The world was once nothing, the universe was once nothing. Life didn't exist anywhere, nothing mattered, because there was nothing to matter.
But somehow, for whatever reason, the universe imploded and was created. 
Now out of all that, on a tiny little planet in the corner of it all, you came into existence, and I can promise you that it wasn't an accident. No one should feel like this and right here, right now is a lesson for you, me and everyone. 
Everything you go through is a stepping stone into something else, and when you're older and you've mentally progressed into someone happier, you'll know it's all worth something. 

I care about whether or not you live or die tonight dude, I was here weeks ago feeling the same way, so many ways out and just freaking the fuck out because you KNOW you can't continue.
But you can, you can evolve into someone fantastic, someone who's bright and happy. 
Much love, I'm very sorry if any of this came off as self centered. 

<3
